facts.fact: At a 4 August 2025 press briefing with the Police CID, the Cyber Security Authority's Director-General Divine Selassie Agbeti said the Authority had taken down multiple accounts spreading AI-generated deepfakes and scams, though takedowns depend on platform owners' own investigations.
